local_review.review_comment: Approved. The diff is scoped to org.apache.kylin:kylin-jdbc:2.0.0 and its allowed metadata, index, stats, metrics, and test files. I checked the generated tests for scaffold placeholders, native-image skips or tolerated failures, hardcoded artifact versions, package/visibility bypasses, direct reflection shortcuts, legacy metadata files, and unrelated coordinates; none were present. Reported dynamic-access coverage is 169/179 (94.4134%), above the new-library gate, and the reported 632 total library plus test-only metadata entries do not trigger the entry-count mismatch probe. I also verified the two native build options rather than treating them as repairs: removing the java.util opening makes the shaded Jackson empty-EnumSet public API test fail with module access denial, and removing HTTP protocol support makes the Avatica HTTP-client public API test fail under GraalVM 25; both options are library-originated and narrowly scoped. The exact Forge finalizer then passed all three native lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test validity, metadata splitting, and statistics generation without changing the publishable tree.
